explainOwner.title: HAMLET for property owners
lines: Got a home in Lagos that sits empty some nights?
HAMLET helps you fill those nights with verified guests. Here's how it works, in four simple steps.
Step one. Join as a partner. Your workspace opens straight away.
Step two. Add your place. Upload photos, describe it, and set your price per night.
Step three. We check it. Who owns it, who's allowed to let it, and we visit to make sure the photos are real.
Only then does your home go live for guests to find.
Step four. Guests send you requests. You choose. Accept, or decline. Nothing is booked without your yes.
When you accept, the guest has forty-eight hours to pay. The booking is only confirmed once the payment is verified.
Guests pay our service fee on top of your price. It never comes out of your rate.
Your exact address stays private until the guest has paid. And a refundable caution deposit helps protect your home.
Your bookings and earnings live in one place. We verify your identity before your first payout.
Your home. Your rules. Verified guests. List your property on HAMLET.

explainManager.title: HAMLET for property managers
explainManager.audience: Authorised property managers and multi-property operators
lines: Managing shortlets for other owners?
Lots of homes. Lots of guests. Lots of messages. HAMLET puts it all in one place.
Think of it as one front desk for every property you look after.
Step one. Join as a partner and choose authorised property manager.
Step two. Add each property with its signed management mandate from the owner. That's how we know you're allowed to let it.
Not sure how to write the listing? Describe the place in your own words, and Horatio, our assistant, can draft it for you.
Step three. We visit every property. Photos, backup power and the address are checked on site before it goes live.
Step four. Requests for all your properties arrive in one workspace. Accept or decline, and keep every calendar up to date.
Guests pay through HAMLET before a booking is confirmed, so you're not chasing transfers.
And when you bring other owners and agents to HAMLET, you can earn referral rewards on their completed bookings.
One workspace. Every property. Add your first property on HAMLET.

explainGuest.title: HAMLET for guests
lines: Booking a shortlet in Lagos shouldn't feel like a gamble.
On HAMLET, every home is visited before it goes live. We check who owns it, that the photos are real, and the backup power.
So how does booking work? Four simple steps.
Step one. Search. Pick an area, your dates, and how many guests.
Step two. Choose a place you love and send a request. You don't pay anything yet.
Step three. The host checks the dates. If they say yes, you have forty-eight hours to pay, safely, through Paystack.
The price you see already includes our fee. Cleaning and a refundable caution deposit are shown before you request. No surprises.
Step four. Once your stay is confirmed, your exact address and arrival guide unlock in your account.
Booking from abroad? You can see prices in pounds or dollars. And if you have questions about an area, just ask Horatio.
Verified stays. Simple booking. Find your stay at hamlet dot rest.

explainHoratio.title: List with Horatio
explainHoratio.audience: Owners and property managers listing one or many apartments
lines: Listing an apartment used to mean filling in form after form.
On HAMLET, you just tell Horatio about it.
Horatio is our listing assistant. Write a short brief, the way you'd describe the place to a friend.
Bedrooms, bathrooms, how many guests, what's included, and your rate. Then tap, generate listing draft.
Horatio fills in the form for you. The title, the area, the rooms, the amenities and the price.
If something's missing, Horatio tells you. It never makes things up. You check the draft, then apply it.
Next, add your photos straight from your phone. HAMLET optimises them and turns them the right way up. Pick your cover photo.
Preview what guests will pay, confirm you're allowed to list it, and submit.
That's one apartment. Got more? Just do it again. A short brief and a few photos for each one.
Then HAMLET checks every listing before it goes live, so guests can trust it.
Tell Horatio. Add photos. Submit. List your apartments on HAMLET.
